comment: Static mirror of MAC-SOP-235 — Separation of Duties Matrix (MacTech CUI Vault). QMS is authoritative. Trust Codex consumes this as read-only reference data and uses it to drive the SCTM 3.1.4 matrix viewer, the preventive provisioning check, and the detective scan. On MAC-SOP-235 release via Doc Control, a sod_matrix_review register entry is auto-seeded; this file is updated to match the released version's sha256 in a follow-on PR.

source.document_name: Separation of Duties Matrix — MacTech CUI Vault (Windows Server 2025 Operational Appendix)

parent_policy.relationship: MAC-SOP-235 is the Windows Server 2025 enclave operational appendix to MAC-POL-235. MAC-POL-235 is the workflow-level personnel SoD policy across MacTech (PRs, ISAs, RAs, QMS Doc Control, PIM, maintenance, access, audit log); this matrix narrows to the named R1–R10 administrative roles inside the Vault.

P.label: Prohibited
P.description: A single identity must never hold both roles. Preventive controls block the combination; detective controls flag any drift.

C.label: Compensating
C.description: Allowed only with documented compensating controls — dual control on sensitive actions, enhanced logging, and quarterly peer review at minimum.

roles.name: System Administrator
roles.summary: OS patching, configuration, performance; Hyper-V host, guest OS, Windows roles.
roles.enforcement_mechanism: JIT activation via PIM; PAW required; LAPS for local-admin rotation.

roles.name: Security Administrator
roles.summary: Baselines, GPO hardening, EDR/AV policy, cryptography; STIG/HVS, BitLocker, AppLocker/WDAC.
roles.enforcement_mechanism: Separate forest admin tier; signed GPO workflow; WDAC policy authorship.

roles.name: Audit Administrator
roles.summary: Audit policy configuration, log forwarding, SIEM ingestion; Event Viewer, WEF subscriptions, SIEM rules.
roles.enforcement_mechanism: Dedicated audit-collector VM; write-once log storage; isolated from R1/R2 span of control.

roles.name: Auditor / Reviewer
roles.summary: Read-only review of audit records; no modify rights.
roles.enforcement_mechanism: Event Log Readers built-in group only; no shell access; no write rights.

roles.name: Identity / Account Administrator
roles.summary: User and group provisioning, MFA enrollment; AD and Entra accounts touching the Vault.
roles.enforcement_mechanism: Delegated OU rights only; not a member of Domain Admins; PIM-eligible.

roles.name: Access Approver (Data Owner)
roles.summary: Authorizes CUI access; approval workflow only.
roles.enforcement_mechanism: Approval workflow inside ticketing / Trust Codex; no AD rights of any kind.

roles.name: Backup Operator
roles.summary: Scheduled backup and restore, media handling.
roles.enforcement_mechanism: Built-in Backup Operators on backup hosts only; not granted on Vault hosts; cannot read CUI in clear.

roles.name: CUI Custodian
roles.summary: CUI ingest, classification, release inside Vault applications.
roles.enforcement_mechanism: Application-layer RBAC inside Vault apps; no OS logon rights to Vault servers.

roles.name: Change Manager / CCB
roles.enforcement_mechanism: Ticketing approver role; no production access.

roles.name: Incident Responder
roles.enforcement_mechanism: Break-glass via PIM activation with MFA, time-boxed; activity forwarded to independent SIEM; post-incident review required.

compensating_controls.label: SA + Sec
controls: Dual-control change tickets for all GPO and WDAC modifications.
R3 reviews change diff before deploy.
Enhanced session logging on PAW.

compensating_controls.label: SA + Id
controls: Dual control on privileged-group additions.
Separate approval chain (R2 or R9) for any AD privileged group change.
Enhanced WEF logging on identity events.

compensating_controls.label: SA + Bkp
controls: Backup operations restricted to backup hosts only; no SA tooling on backup hosts.
Restore operations require dual control with R5 or R9.

compensating_controls.label: SA + IR
controls: R10 PIM activation requires R2 approval (cannot be self-approved by an SA holder).
Incident-only timeboxing.
Mandatory post-incident SoD review for any R1/R10-combined identity.

compensating_controls.label: Sec + Id
controls: Dual control on Tier 0 group changes.
Identity changes touching MAC-Vault-SecAdmins require R9 (CCB) sign-off.
Enhanced Entra audit alerts on the combined identity.

compensating_controls.label: Sec + IR
controls: R10 activation by a Sec-role holder requires R9 (CCB) approval.
Standing review of all incident actions by an independent R3-domain auditor.

compensating_controls.label: AuA + Aud
controls: Discouraged but permitted in small teams.
Quarterly peer review of audit configuration changes by an external reviewer.
Written CISO acknowledgment of the residual risk.

compensating_controls.label: Id + Cus
controls: Custodian activities by an identity that also provisions accounts must be peer-reviewed.
Provisioning actions for own role family prohibited.

compensating_controls.label: Apv + Cus
controls: Same identity cannot approve and process the same access request.
Ticket workflow enforces approver ≠ requester ≠ processor.

fail_open_sla.rationale: Preventive workflow fails open if Trust Codex is unreachable; detective scan catches the resulting conflict within the SLA window. Documented in MAC-SOP-235 §7.1.
